tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is pale shore; dark is deep water.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Lowest background tone: footers, page edges, the bottom of the shore gradient.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid panels for long text, decks, print and reduced transparency.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Solid panel one step up: menus, popovers, inputs on a surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, frost glass and every hue's glass.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground, surface and frost glass. At least 4.5:1 on each in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only. Below 4.5:1 on purpose.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and quiet borders on solid surfaces and frost panels.

tokens.name: frost-fill
tokens.usage: Clear frosted panel fill for cards and lists, with blur behind it.

tokens.name: frost-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Heavier frosted fill for modals, toasts and panels with more text.

tokens.name: frost-edge
tokens.usage: 1px rim on frosted panels.

tokens.name: frost-glass
tokens.usage: Clear white sea glass: secondary buttons, neutral chips, default pebbles. Body of frost glass; the opaque version of this glass, for the cover, art and places that cannot be translucent; it pairs with frost-rim.

tokens.name: frost-rim
tokens.usage: Deeper edge of frost glass, and solid frost fills in charts and art. Not a text ground on its own.

tokens.name: frost-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on frost-glass and frost-rim, and frost-tinted text on ground and surface.

tokens.name: frost-pigment
tokens.usage: Vivid frost that pebbles lay down at low opacity (about a third) over white, so the glass reads saturated yet light and see-through. Never a solid fill or a text color.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one solid accent, deep seafoam: switch tracks when on, checked checkboxes, progress rings, the current step. At least 3:1 against ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Check marks and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer behind modals and sheets.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled track of switches and progress rings.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Switch thumbs.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element; at least 3:1 on ground, surface and every hue's glass.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons. Always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons. Always with a word or icon.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page or slide.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers, slide titles, modal titles on large screens.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Tinted glass pebbles, worn smooth by the sea.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a display headline.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and panel titles in apps.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each control is a piece of tinted glass with a soft shadow beneath it.
styles.usage: Default running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Labels inside buttons, tabs, chips and fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow labels. Set the text in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap and the minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Glass card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Spacing between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Spacing between sections on small screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Spacing between sections on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, keyboard keys.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs inside panels, small tiles, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, nested panels, toasts that wrap.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, lists and widgets. Nested elements step down so corners stay concentric.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every pebble control: buttons, tab bars, chips, fields, the nav bar.

tokens.name: pebble
tokens.usage: The neutral sea-glass stack at control size: a soft white glow inside the top, a fainter one rising from the bottom, and a crisp slab shadow straight below that gives the glass its thickness. The bundle adds a tinted glow under each hue.

tokens.name: pebble-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed pebbles and the selected inner pill of a tab bar.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Frosted panels: cards, lists, widgets, toasts.

tokens.name: float
tokens.usage: Modals, menus and hovered cards.

tokens.name: thumb-shadow
tokens.usage: Small drop under switch thumbs.

glass.note: Frosted panels use backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-saturate)). Pebbles carry a grain set by --grain-opacity in the bundle.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind frosted panels and the nav bar.

tokens.name: glass-blur-strong
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for modals and sheets.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Lets background color glow through frosted panels.
